I'm weighing whether to commit to deleting grasp_end on both sides, since it seems recoverable from grasp_point coordinates matching a head or tail entry in the scene. But I'm wary of the risk if the pick fails and the peg shifts, since that could invalidate the grasp_point coordinates used to infer it.

Deciding the one-field-one-fact rule and necessity argument outweigh this risk, I'll commit to the deletion and make the corresponding subgoal edits: removing grasp_end references from Rule 1 and Rule 3, tweaking the gripper-open percentage to "22-25%" in Rule 2, and making matching minor adjustments to the memory policy and annotator prompt descriptions for grasp_point.
